sentences: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
translations: 根据最高法院周四的一项裁决，各州将能够强制更多人在网上购物时缴纳销售税，这一裁决将使购物者的钱包变瘪，但对各州来说却是一场重大的财政胜利。

sentences: The Supreme Court’s opinion Thursday overruled a pair of decades-old decisions that states said cost them billions of dollars in lost revenue annually.
The decisions made it more difficult for states to collect sales tax on certain online purchases.
translations: 最高法院周四的意见推翻了两项已有数十年历史的裁决，各州称这些裁决每年使它们损失数十亿美元的收入。
这些裁决使各州更难对某些网上购物征收销售税。

sentences: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer’s purchase to a state where the business didn’t have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn’t have to collect sales tax for the state.
Customers were generally responsible for paying the sales tax to the state themselves if they weren’t charged it, but most didn’t realize they owed it and few paid.
translations: 法院推翻的案件认为，如果企业将客户的购买商品运往一个该企业没有实体存在（如仓库或办公室）的州，该企业就不必为该州代收销售税。
如果顾客未被收取销售税，他们通常有责任自行向州政府缴纳，但大多数人没有意识到自己欠税，而且很少有人缴纳。

sentences: Justice Anthony Kennedy wrote that the previous decisions were flawed.
“Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the states,” he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.
Kennedy wrote that the rule “limited states’ ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field.”
translations: 大法官安东尼·肯尼迪写道，之前的裁决存在缺陷。
“每年，实体存在规则都进一步脱离经济现实，并给各州造成巨大的收入损失，”他在一份由其他四位大法官联署的意见书中写道。
肯尼迪写道，该规则“限制了各州寻求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平的竞争环境中竞争。”

sentences: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
Now, rivals will be charging sales tax where they hadn’t before.
Big chains have been collecting sales tax nationwide because they typically have physical stores in whatever state a purchase is being shipped to.
Amazon. com, with its network of warehouses, also collects sales tax in every state that charges it, though third-party sellers who use the site don’t have to.
translations: 这项裁决对于在许多州都有业务的大型连锁店来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常已经对网上购物征收销售税。
现在，竞争对手将在以前不征税的地方征收销售税。
大型连锁店一直在全国范围内征收销售税，因为它们通常在商品运往的任何州都有实体店。
亚马逊凭借其仓库网络，也在每个征收销售税的州代收销售税，尽管使用该网站的第三方卖家不必如此。

sentences: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
Sellers that use eBay and Etsy, which provide platforms for smaller sellers, also haven’t been collecting sales tax nationwide.
Under the ruling Thursday, states can pass laws requiring out-of-state sellers to collect the state’s sales tax from customers and send it to the state.
translations: 到目前为止，许多仅在单个州或少数几个州有实体存在的卖家，在向这些州以外的地址发货时，一直能够避免收取销售税。
使用eBay和Etsy（为较小卖家提供平台）的卖家也一直没有在全国范围内征收销售税。
根据周四的裁决，各州可以通过法律，要求州外卖家向客户收取本州的销售税并将其上缴给该州。

sentences: Retail trade groups praised the ruling, saying it levels the playing field for local and online businesses.
The losers, said retail analyst Neil Saunders, are online-only retailers, especially smaller ones.
Those retailers may face headaches complying with various state sales tax laws.
The Small Business & Entrepreneurship Council advocacy group said in a statement, “Small businesses and internet entrepreneurs are not well served at all by this decision.”
translations: 零售贸易团体称赞这项裁决，称它为本地和在线企业创造了公平的竞争环境。
零售分析师尼尔·桑德斯表示，输家是纯在线零售商，尤其是规模较小的零售商。
这些零售商在遵守各州不同的销售税法方面可能会面临头疼的问题。
小企业与创业委员会倡导组织在一份声明中表示：“小企业和互联网企业家完全没有从这项决定中得到良好服务。”

sentences:
36. The Supreme Court decision Thursday will
A. put most online businesses in a dilemma.
B. force some states to cut sales tax.
C. make more online shoppers pay sales tax.
D. better businesses’ relations with states.
translations:
36. 最高法院周四的裁决将
A. 使大多数在线企业陷入两难境地。
B. 迫使一些州削减销售税。
C. 让更多在线购物者支付销售税。
D. 改善企业与各州的关系。

sentences:
37. It can be learned from Paragraphs 2 and 3 that the overruled decisions
A. were widely criticized by online purchasers.
B. have cost consumers a lot over the years.
C. have led to the dominance of e-commerce.
D. were considered unfavorable by states.
translations:
37. 从第二段和第三段可以得知，被推翻的裁决
A. 受到了网购者的广泛批评。
B. 多年来让消费者付出了高昂代价。
C. 导致了电子商务的主导地位。
D. 被各州认为是不利的。

sentences:
38. According to Justice Anthony Kennedy, the physical presence rule has
A. hindered economic development.
B. harmed fair market competition.
C. boosted growth in states’ revenue.
D. brought prosperity to the country.
translations:
38. 根据安东尼·肯尼迪大法官的观点，物理存在规则已经
A. 阻碍了经济发展。
B. 损害了公平市场竞争。
C. 促进了各州收入的增长。
D. 为国家带来了繁荣。

sentences:
39. Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?
A. Big-chain owners.
B. Third-party sellers.
C. Internet entrepreneurs.
D. Small retailers.
translations:
39. 谁最有可能欢迎最高法院的裁决？
A. 大型连锁店所有者。
B. 第三方卖家。
C. 互联网企业家。
D. 小型零售商。

sentences:
40. In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author
A. presents its main points with conflicting views on them.
B. gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences.
C. cites some cases related to it and analyzes their implications.
D. describes the long and complicated process of its making.
translations:
40. 在讨论周四最高法院的裁决时，作者
A. 陈述其要点并附上相互矛盾的观点。
B. 对其进行了事实性描述并讨论了其后果。
C. 引用了与之相关的案例并分析了其含义。
D. 描述了其形成漫长而复杂的过程。
